name: Terminal
summary: A terminal on your machine, inside Studio, plus your team's agents side by side, live, where Studio has them. Everyone signed in sees the same view, each through their own sign-in.
_calls_note: No provider: what is set up comes from the Studio's own /api/studio/place (terminal, team and agents: each its path, or null). The views are the Studio's own /terminal/ (tools/start-terminal.mjs in the SDK), /team/, and the agents' watch and type paths with their list at /api/agents/terminals and Add view at /api/agents/ensure, which a Studio serves only behind server hooks.
